text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-U.S. ambassador Jones: There might soon be a declaration with regard to the consultative group for the reconstruction of Lebanon -- formed under the April ceasefire understanding.
-Preparations underway for the south Lebanon round of elections on Sunday. Hizbollah and Amal candidates to run on one list.
-Hizbollah Secretary General Sheikh Nasrallah: I will explain at the Nabatiyyeh rally everything about the Amal-Hizbollah coalition.
-Banque de la Mediterranee to issue $150 million Eurodeposit programme through Merrill Lynch International -- the first Euro-CDs to be issued by a Lebanese commercial bank.
-Byblos Bank's $50-million three-year Euronote issue will be priced at minimum of 2.75 percent per year over three-year U.S. treasuries as at September 9, 1996.
-Berri announces his list today. Twenty one candidates on the coalition list in south Lebanon and four independent candidates in Sidon.
